result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages, limits, the data-processing condition for cyber/privacy insurance, legally required workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it unnecessarily requires every policy to remain in force for one year after the term, which is not in the playbook and is particularly awkward for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage. It also duplicates section number 14.10 rather than renumbering the existing provision. The original commercial terms are otherwise preserved.
